key_insight: NLP of EHR clinical notes uncovered symptom-based MND subgroups that go beyond traditional onset-site classifications.
clinical_relevance: These data-driven phenotypes may help stratify prognosis and support more tailored symptom-focused care in motor neuron disease.
method: Extracted symptoms from 2,361 confirmed MND patients’ clinical notes using MedCAT NLP
Filtered concepts to UMLS sign/symptom terms and removed negated findings
Clustered binary symptom profiles with latent class analysis and compared survival across groups
evidence_signal: The abstract reports four clusters from first notes and three from all notes, with significant survival differences across clusters (log-rank p < 0.001).
watch_item: Findings come from a single tertiary-center retrospective EHR dataset, so portability and coding/narrative variation across sites may affect generalization.
paper_title: Symptom-based phenotype discovery in motor neuron disease using natural language processing of electronic health records
